Name: Festive Fireplaces
Author: WitchDearling
Description:
Five cozy fireplaces for Christmas/Feast of the Winter Star.

Replaces the default brick, stone, monster, stove, and elegant fireplaces with more festive versions. (No iridium replacement, sorry.)
As far as I'm aware this will only change player fireplaces. Those in town will remain default.

This is in part made for the Stardew Valley discord's Winter 2019 event, with the inspiration of "cozy" bringing to mind warm nights by the fireplace.


[b]Installing:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ are up to date
[*]Download the file, unzip, and place folder into your /Mods folder
[*]Play and enjoy!
[/list]
